units.source_text: “只要还下这盘棋，我的病就不会好转。

en.t: As long as I keep playing this game, my illness will not get better.

units.source_text: 我常常突然这么想，把这盘棋全扔在这儿，我就舒服啦。

en.t: I often suddenly think that if I threw this whole game away right here, I would feel relieved.

units.source_text: 然而，我不能做出这种对技艺不忠的事情来。”

en.t: And yet, I cannot do something so unfaithful to the art.”
